heidi.line: And Uncle Walt, he's home with Heidi
stanza: But when they came on down to Texas
We all showed them how to swing
And old Champ's still on the guitar
And Uncle Walt, he's home with Heidi
And I'll bend my knees neatly to its needs
Tough as rocky streams, steady is the speed

tidy.songTitle: Last Words of a Shooting Star
tidy.line: And I am relieved that I'd left my room tidy
stanza: All of this turbulence wasn't forecasted
And I am relieved that I'd left my room tidy
They'll think of me kindly when they come for my things
Think how snug it will be
When it's just you and me
We'll have chums over every Friday
